name: Jared Willets
bio: Jared is a third-year CSE major with a passion for making low-cost software products. Recently he has been exploring low-cost household automation and STEM kit creation.

name: Ariela Ramos-Zinter
bio: Ariela is a third-year ISE major hoping to go into manufacturing and CAD. Her hobbies are sewing, painting, and reading.

name: Filip Lillard
bio: Filip is a junior in Electrical Engineering. He is interested in PCB layout and design, chip design, and gaming hardware and software. His hobbies include gaming, dungeons & dragons, reading, and cooking.

name: Salah Ketfi
bio: Salah is an engineering student who enjoys sports and learning new things. He is interested in electronics and technology, and motivated to grow skills through teamwork, hands on projects, and active involvement in the club.

name: Halina Tri-Leanza
bio: Halina is a senior pursuing Electrical and Computer Engineering with a strong interest in hands-on design and emerging technologies. She hopes to pursue patent law, combining technical expertise with advocacy to help protect innovation and break barriers to accessible pathways for new ideas.

name: Edward Lui
bio: Edward is a second year aerospace PhD student with a BS in CSE studying space robotics. His hobbies include hiking, swimming, gaming, sailing, and photography.

name: Nathan Cheng
bio: Nathan is a first year CSE major with interests in 3D printing and robotics. In his spare time he enjoys animation, chess, squash, table tennis, and 3D modeling.

name: Cadence Forney
bio: Cadence is a first year EE major with interests in robotics and 3D printing. In her spare time she enjoys ceramics, fencing and 3D modeling.

name: Junxiong Hui
bio: Junxiong is a second-year ECE major focused on Energy & Power. Outside of academia, he likes playing table tennis and cooking.

name: Steven Bibyk
bio: Professor Bibyk is an Associate Professor of ECE at The Ohio State University. His research includes advanced circuits for signal processing and embedded communication systems.
